tools.name: verify_company_claims
tools.title: Verify company claims
tools.description: Resolve a company, compare supported claims with current company evidence, preserve a proof record, and optionally monitor verified claims for change. This call consumes normal CompanyProof claim credits and writes to the account evidence ledger.

name.description: Legal or trading name used to resolve the company.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 jurisdiction code, for example GB.

answer.description: Natural-language answer from which CompanyProof should extract supported claims.

monitor.description: Keep verified claims connected to change monitoring. Requires an eligible live key.

idempotency_key.description: Stable key for safely retrying the same verification.

tools.name: search_companies
tools.title: Search companies
tools.description: Find ranked CompanyProof company matches by name, registration number, VAT/tax identifier or ticker, optionally narrowed by subdivision and city/state. This read-only operation requires an active CompanyProof evaluation or paid plan and live account access, and consumes one shared claim credit.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 jurisdiction code, for example GB.

subdivision.description: Optional ISO-style country-state code for US, CA or CN, for example US-CA.

city_or_state.description: Optional city or state names used to narrow resolution (up to 10 values).

limit.description: Maximum number of ranked matches to return (1–10).

identifier.description: Official registration number, up to 80 characters.

tools.name: get_company_profile
tools.title: Get company profile
tools.description: Retrieve a CompanyProof company profile and enrichment payload by the opaque company ID returned from search_companies. This read-only operation requires an active CompanyProof evaluation or paid plan and live account access, and consumes one shared claim credit.

company_id.description: Opaque CompanyProof company ID returned by search_companies.
